title: Blood and Honor
description: Yorin Hask and his Black Wolves undercut us on two contracts through Dalhurst by quoting half rate and skimping the escort. When his clients lose cargo, they blame the Iron Company's name. Meet him at the Crossroads and stop it.

objectives.description: Meet Hask and the Black Wolves at the Crossroads
Confront Hask over the undercut contracts
Break the Black Wolves in the fight Hask picked
Report to Steele how it ended with Hask

notes: Named rival Yorin Hask, invented, no bible basis. Threat: undercut contracts are costing the Company its reputation by association, not gold directly. Giver motive: Steele wants the underbidding to stop, method unspecified. Consequence: the description's promised negotiation/merger/outmaneuver paths are not wired - resolve_conflict is a single optional kill objective with no choice_consequences behind it. A full fix needs a real OR group (negotiate/outmaneuver/fight) added to the objectives array, which this pass cannot do.
